title: Bookshelf, Vinyl & Soundscapes
subtitle: Books that shaped my mindset, melodies on repeat, and acoustic singing recordings
shelfIntro: A curated corner of philosophy, technology, cozy fiction, acoustic indie playlists, and the records that spin while I write code or sketch.

books.title: Atomic Habits
books.author: James Clear
books.favoriteQuote: You do not rise to the level of your goals. You fall to the level of your systems.
books.notes: Changed how I approach daily software craft and habit stacking. Micro-improvements compounding over years create exponential growth.

books.title: Clean Code
books.author: Robert C. Martin
books.favoriteQuote: Any fool can write code that a computer can understand. Good programmers write code that humans can understand.
books.notes: Essential principles of readability, meaningful naming, small single-responsibility functions, and refactoring with courage.

books.title: The Little Prince
books.author: Antoine de Saint-Exupéry
books.favoriteQuote: It is only with the heart that one can see rightly; what is essential is invisible to the eye.
books.notes: A timeless reminder to look beyond superficial metrics and retain child-like wonder, curiosity, and empathy.

books.title: Thinking, Fast and Slow
books.author: Daniel Kahneman
books.favoriteQuote: A reliable way to make people believe in falsehoods is frequent repetition, because familiarity is not easily distinguished from truth.
books.notes: Fascinating analysis of System 1 intuition vs System 2 deliberative thought. Deeply influences UX design and user decision psychology.

books.title: Designing Data-Intensive Applications
books.author: Martin Kleppmann
books.favoriteQuote: Reliability, scalability, and maintainability are not achieved by accident; they require deliberate engineering.
books.notes: The definitive masterclass on distributed systems, replication, partitioning, consistency models, and transaction semantics.

musicVibes.title: Acoustic Covers & Vocal Sessions
musicVibes.notes: Singing unplugged acoustic numbers with natural reverberation and warm chords.

musicVibes.title: Midnight Coding Lo-Fi
musicVibes.notes: Soft Rhodes electric piano keys, mellow kick drums, and subtle tape hiss for uninterrupted coding flow state.

musicVibes.title: Classical Sitar & Morning Ragas
musicVibes.notes: Early morning ragas for clarity of mind before tackling complex distributed system bugs.
